text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P2 runtime alert — us-west-2 queue depth spike. 503s from /v1/generate, error rate 7% over 5m. Paging #eng-oncall
Alex: taking this. what's the customer impact? any high-traffic tenants showing failures?
Samantha: multiple tenants seeing elevated latencies, embeddings most affected. Long tails ~80-120s on some calls. Inflight global ~850/1000, but low-priority lanes are saturated.
Mike: on it. traces point to KV cache thrash + a handful of long-running requests holding worker slots. Proposed live mitigations: 1) reduce max_inflight for low-priority lane 200->50, 2) increase premium lane cap 300->500, 3) enable soft-shedding for free tier, 4) tighten runtime request timeout 60s->30s.
Leslie: agree with that plan. Soft-shed will drop expensive long-context requests instead of queueing. I'll own the timeout change and the shedding toggle.
Alex: prioritize low-risk quickest wins first. Mike, can you post the commands you need? Samantha, prep a short customer heads-up for affected tenants (note we may throttle non-paying dev keys).
Mike: executing config change now. Command I will run:
```
curl -XPOST "http://config.internal/v1/set" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"changes":[{"key":"runtime.max_inflight.low","value":"50"},{"key":"runtime.max_inflight.premium","value":"500"}]}'
```
Mike: and toggling soft-shedding policy for tier=free:
```
curl -XPOST "http://config.internal/v1/feature-toggle" -d '{"feature":"soft_shed_free_tier","enabled":true}'
```
Ops-bot: config change accepted — change-id cfg-2026-789 applied (owner: Mike).
Ops-bot: feature toggle applied — ft-2026-455 (owner: Mike).
Leslie: rolling runtime timeout change (60s -> 30s) as a config hotpatch. Command: `./tools/rollout --target=runtime --config runtime.request_timeout=30s --fast-apply`. Running in canary on 10% first.
Leslie: canary ok after 2m, continuing to 50%. No increased errors observed in canary.
IncidentBot: alert update — error rate dropped to 2.1% over last 3m, 503 count decreasing.
Samantha: sending quick note to impacted customers: "We observed elevated latency and errors in us-west-2 earlier; we've applied traffic shaping and timeouts to stabilize service. You may experience throttling on free-tier/dev keys; paid tenants given higher inflight capacity. If you see persistent issues, reply here or open a ticket."
Alex: good. keep monitoring dashboards and logs (priority: queue depth, 5xx rate, per-tenant errors). If error rate <1% for 10m we can unwind the more aggressive limits.
Mike: capturing follow-up action items: 1) investigate root cause KV thrash / cache eviction patterns, 2) consider prefix-KV caching for long-sequence workloads, 3) evaluate autoscaling trigger for inflight vs queue depth. I'll create tickets.
Leslie: also add a regression alert for runtime request-time distribution to catch future tail regressions.
IncidentBot: alert quieted — current error rate 0.9% over 2m.
Alex: great work team. Leaving this open for 30m post-stable to confirm. :thumbsup:
Samantha: will post postmortem note and customer follow-up if anything changes.
Mike: filing follow-ups now (TICKET-4821, TICKET-4822).
Leslie: rolling back canary if we see any regressions, otherwise will promote timeout globally after 30m.
Alex: thanks all — standing down unless we see another spike.
